intent: Hold the crumbs of a breadcrumb trail, and the separators between them, as one ordered list.
typical_uses: The one list inside a Breadcrumb, alternating items and separators

dont_use_when.situation: The row of page items inside a Pagination

invariants.text: The list is a wrapping flex row (breadcrumb.module.css `.list`: `flex-wrap: wrap`, `overflow-wrap: break-word`, gap var(--space-1)) with no bullets, margin or padding, so a trail wider than its container continues on the next line rather than truncating or scrolling.

a11y.by: breadcrumb.test.tsx asserts getByRole('list') resolves to an OL element

good.title: Items with a separator between them

bad.title: A separator placed inside an item
bad.why: BreadcrumbSeparator renders an `li` of its own, so inside an item it nests one list item in another; it belongs beside the items, as a direct child of the list.
